events.label: Lane step
events.trigger: The animal hops to the next lane.
events.prompt: A single soft muted pat, like a fingertip gently patting a small pillow, short soft felt tap with a warm mid tone, quiet and calm, no bass boom, no click, no whoosh, no spring, 0.15 seconds, subtle unobtrusive mobile game step sound, no voice, no animal, no music

events.label: Step on a rooftop
events.trigger: The animal hops onto a corrugated roof. One impact only: the road hop carries a second click for the barrier, which nothing off the street has.
events.prompt: A single light hoof step on a corrugated metal rooftop. Exactly one impact — one dull metallic tap, no second click, no ringing tail, no reverb. Dry, close, muted, quick. Very short, under 0.3 seconds.

events.label: Step on stairs
events.trigger: The animal hops onto the harbour stairs.
events.prompt: A single soft hoof step landing on old stone stairs. Exactly one clean impact — no second click, no echo, no reverb tail. Dry, close-mic, light and quick, like a small goat hopping down one step. Very short, under 0.3 seconds.

events.label: Step on the pier
events.trigger: The animal hops onto the pier decking or a boat.
events.prompt: A single light hoof step on a weathered wooden dock plank. Exactly one impact — one hollow wooden knock, no second click, no echo, no rattle afterwards. Dry, close, quick. Very short, under 0.3 seconds.

events.label: Safe arrival
events.trigger: Road barrier closing after a safe landing, except the first step where the Cashout-ready chime takes priority.
events.prompt: A single short pair of small goat hoof clops on dry pavement, light rounded woody taps with a tiny gritty scuff, playful tactile mobile game movement sound. 0.35 seconds, isolated dry close sound, no voice, no music, no ambience, no ringing.

events.label: Splash
events.prompt: One small animal falling into water, a rounded plop and short gentle water splash with a few droplets. Compact playful mobile game effect, 0.65 seconds, isolated, no voice, no music, no ambience.

events.label: Roof collapse
events.trigger: A roof gives way under the animal.
events.prompt: One small wooden roof giving way under a goat: quick dry wood crack followed by a soft brief tumble of lightweight boards. Compact playful game falling sound, 0.75 seconds, no explosion, no voice, no music, no ambience.

events.label: Goat squash
events.prompt: One very cute cartoon baby goat surprise sound: a soft squishy pop followed by a tiny gentle bleat, meh. Playful rubber toy squash reaction, cheerful and harmless, 0.6 seconds. No distressed cry, no harsh impact, no music, isolated dry sound.

events.label: Chicken squash
events.prompt: One very cute cartoon chicken surprise sound: a soft squishy pop followed by a tiny bubbly cluck. Playful rubber toy squash reaction, cheerful and harmless, 0.6 seconds. No distressed scream, no harsh impact, no music, isolated dry sound.

events.label: Dog squash
events.prompt: A goofy cartoon street dog gets bumped: a soft squishy rubber toy pop immediately followed by one short clear dog bark "ruff!" with a silly surprised yip at the end, unmistakably a medium sized dog, playful and harmless. 0.7 seconds, isolated dry close sound. No bird, no chicken, no cluck, no squeak toy whistle, no pain yelp, no growl, no music, no ambience.

events.label: Round start
events.trigger: Legacy round-start signal; replaced by Cashout becomes available to avoid overlapping sounds.

events.label: Background music
events.trigger: Loops in the background while Music is on.
events.prompt: Calm looping background music bed for a casual mobile road-crossing game: light playful ukulele and soft claps over a gentle walking beat, cheerful but unobtrusive, mid tempo, no vocals, no build-up, no climax, seamless 30 second loop, consistent from start to end, instrumental only

events.label: Car collision layer
events.trigger: Once at actual vehicle contact, underneath the animal reaction.
events.prompt: One compact soft cartoon vehicle bump impact, muted rubbery thud and a short metal body rattle. Friendly arcade goat crossing game collision, 0.55 seconds, no harsh crash, no glass, no voice, no music, isolated dry sound.

events.label: Cashout becomes available
events.trigger: UI signal after the first successful step. Uses the same chime as Goat Gold start.
